meta.name: ai-video-generation
meta.description: Generate AI videos on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — a smart router across the full video-model catalog: HappyHorse 1.0 (Arena #1, native in-pass audio), Wan-AI Wan 2-7 (open weights, audio-driven lip-sync), ByteDance Seedance v2 / 1-5 / 1-0 (multi-modal cinematic), Kling 3.0 / 2-6, Google Veo 3-1, MiniMax Hailuo 2-3, ByteDance Dreamina 3-0. Covers text-to-video (t2v), image-to-video (i2v), and Veo's video-extend endpoint. The skill picks the right model for the user's intent (Arena-#1 quality, multi-shot character identity, in-pass audio, cinematic motion, fastest path, sub-15s clip, longest duration) and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate video", "make a video", "text to video", "t2v", "image to video", "i2v", "animate", "AI video", "make X move", "video from prompt", "video from image", or any explicit ask to produce a video clip from prompt or still.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的文字描述或图片，自动选择最合适的 AI 模型来生成视频，包括文字转视频、图片转视频，还能延长已有视频。
howto.when: 当你说“生成视频”“制作视频”“文字转视频”“图片转视频”“让XX动起来”等与视频生成相关的指令时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一段海边日落的视频。
say.note: Claude 会用默认模型生成约5秒的视频。

say.text: 把这张图片变成视频，让海浪动起来。
say.note: Claude 会用图片转视频模型处理。

say.text: 生成一段带音频的广告视频，15秒。
say.note: Claude 会选择支持音频的模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate AI videos from your text descriptions or images, automatically picking the best model for text-to-video, image-to-video, or extending existing videos.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "generate video", "make a video", "text to video", "image to video", "animate", or any explicit request to produce a video clip from a prompt or still.

say_en.text: Generate a video of a sunset at the beach.
say_en.note: Claude uses the default model to create a ~5s clip.

say_en.text: Turn this image into a video with moving waves.
Create a 15-second ad video with audio.
say_en.note: Claude picks a model that supports in-pass audio.
